title: 친구에게 묻기: 뭐 먹을래요? 어디 갈래요?
objective: By the end, you can ask what someone wants to do with -(으)ㄹ래요?, say what you want with -(으)ㄹ래요 or 안 -(으)ㄹ래요, and choose between -(으)ㄹ래요? and -(으)ㄹ까요?.
summary: Learn to ask what someone wants to do with -(으)ㄹ래요?, how to answer it, and how it is different from -(으)ㄹ까요?.

task.title: Ask and answer with -(으)ㄹ래요
task.line: Read each item, then write, choose, fix, or order the words so they fit the situation.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel (보다 → 볼래요?)
forms.means: Do you want to …? You ask what the listener wants to do.
forms.exampleMeaning: Do you want to see a movie together this weekend?

forms.when: The verb stem ends in ㄹ. Keep the ㄹ and add -래요 (만들다 → 만들래요?)
forms.exampleMeaning: Do you want to make tteokbokki together?

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a consonant (앉다 → 앉을래요?)
forms.means: Do you want to …? / Would you like to …?
forms.exampleMeaning: Would you like to sit here?

forms.when: In an answer, when you say what you want or don't want to do. The subject is 'I'.
forms.means: I'll … / I want to … / I don't want to …
forms.example: 저는 집에 있을래요. 밖에 안 나갈래요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'll stay home. I don't want to go out.

forms.when: You suggest something ('Shall we …?') or ask for advice ('Should I …?').
forms.means: It asks the listener's opinion. -(으)ㄹ래요? asks what the listener wants.

watchOut: 음악 듣을래요? (X) → 음악 들을래요? (O): With 듣다 and 걷다, ㄷ changes to ㄹ before -을래요 (걷다 → 걸을래요).
만들을래요? (X) → 만들래요? (O): If the stem ends in ㄹ, don't add 을. Just add -래요.
동생이 피자를 먹을래요. (X) → 동생이 피자를 먹고 싶어 해요. (O): Use -(으)ㄹ래요 only for 'I' in statements and 'you' in questions, not for other people.
A: 커피 마실래요? B: 네, 마실까요. (X) → 네, 마실래요. (O): When someone asks with -(으)ㄹ래요?, answer with -(으)ㄹ래요.
exercises: Change the verb in ( ) to -(으)ㄹ래요?: ① 여기서 사진 (찍다) ② 이 노래 같이 (듣다) ③ 내일 우리 집에서 (놀다) ④ 제 우산 같이 (쓰다)
Choose the right answer: A: 귤 좀 먹을래요? B: 아니요, 저는 배불러서 (안 먹을래요 / 안 먹을까요).
Choose -(으)ㄹ래요? or -(으)ㄹ까요?: ① You don't know what to order, so you ask your friend for advice. 저는 뭐 (주문할래요? / 주문할까요?) ② You ask your friend which one she wants. 민지 씨는 어느 거 (고를래요? / 고를까요?)
Your older sister wants to rest. Fix the sentence with -고 싶어 해요 (wants to) and keep 언니가 as the subject: 언니가 오늘 집에서 쉴래요.
Fill in the blank with -(으)ㄹ래요 (you want to stay home and read): A: 내일 등산 갈래요? B: 아니요, 저는 집에서 책을 ____.
Put the words in order to make a question: 걸을래요? / 같이 / 한강에서 / 저녁에
answers: ① 찍을래요? ② 들을래요? ③ 놀래요? ④ 쓸래요?
언니가 오늘 집에서 쉬고 싶어 해요. (also: 언니가 오늘 집에서 쉬고 싶어해요.)
저녁에 한강에서 같이 걸을래요? (also: 한강에서 저녁에 같이 걸을래요? / 저녁에 같이 한강에서 걸을래요? / 같이 저녁에 한강에서 걸을래요? / 같이 한강에서 저녁에 걸을래요? / 한강에서 같이 저녁에 걸을래요?)
